THE UTTAMA SEVA PADAKKAMA - 2017

IT is hereby notified that HIS EXCELLENCY THE PRESIDENT of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Commanderin Chief of the Armed Forces has been graciously pleased to award the Uttama Seva Padakkama for the years Two ThousandSeventeen in terms of regulation four of the Presidential Warrant instituting, constituting and creating the Uttama SevaPadakkama published in the Government Gazette Extraordinary No. 156/5 of 01st September, 1981 to the persons named inthe schedule hereto.
By His Excellancy’s Command,HEMASIRI FERNANDO,Secretary,Ministry of Defence.
Colombo,March 2019.
